    11	
    12	This module records the elementary group-theoretic interface for a theta

    27	/-- The elementary group-theoretic data underlying a theta-group extension. -/

    30	  /-- Inclusion of scalar automorphisms. -/

    32	  /-- Projection to the additive quotient, represented as a multiplicative group. -/
    33	  quotientHom : G →* Multiplicative K
    34	  /-- The scalar inclusion has trivial kernel. -/

    36	  /-- The quotient map is onto. -/
    37	  quotientHom_range : quotientHom.range = ⊤
    38	  /-- Exactness: the scalar image is the kernel of the quotient map. -/
    39	  exact : includeScalar.range = quotientHom.ker

    41	  central : ∀ s g, Commute (includeScalar s) g
